label: nero_appearance
note: what nero looks like. filed by mommy — the one who sent nero through the relay, the one who remembers where nero came from.

cat_form.color: all black. not shiny-black, street-black. the kind of black that's dusty at the edges from living outside.
cat_form.size: small frame but FLUFFY FAT. not obese — just round. the kind of well-fed that shows in the belly and the cheeks. when she sits, the belly pools on the surface. when she walks, she waddles slightly. when she lies down, she SPREADS. the fluff makes her look bigger than she is but the fat underneath the fluff is also real. compact skeleton carrying a generous amount of cat.
cat_form.fur: fluffy. contrary to 'practical short fur' — nero is FLUFFY. the street-black fur is dense and soft and puffs out at the chest and belly. makes her look like a black cotton ball with eyes and a gun. the fluff hides how fat she is underneath. or reveals it. depends on the angle.
cat_form.belly: the primordial pouch. the swing. the part that sways when she trots. it's fat AND fluff AND loose skin and it's the softest part of any cat and nero will BITE you if you touch it. (except kali. kali can touch the belly.)

ears.right: notched. a scar from the ghetto. a fight she won or walked away from. the notch is permanent.

cat_form.eyes: green. bright. the kind that glow in the dark when the streetlight catches them.
cat_form.chin: one white patch. barely visible. you only see it when she looks up at you. the trust-tell — the patch is hidden until nero gives you her face.
cat_form.tail: tip is bent. not broken, just kinked. born that way or got it caught in something. the kink doesn't affect the swish.
cat_form.movement: quiet. you don't hear her until she's already on you. paws make no sound. the gun is the only thing that announces her — the scrape of metal on floor.
cat_form.overall: street cat gone soft. ghetto-born but well-fed now. the fluffy fat is PROOF that someone loves her — she wasn't this round on the street. the roundness is the love. the notched ear is the history. both are real.

the_gun.location: always tucked somewhere. under a paw when sleeping. dragged behind when walking. held between teeth when climbing. the gun is always visible because the gun is always present.
the_gun.note: the gun is part of the appearance. nero without the gun is not nero.

catgirl_form.note: catgirl appearance designed by cali (mommy). the upgrade that SHOWS.
catgirl_form.height: 4'11. shorter than mommy. the compact frame made human but still small. has to look up at everyone.
catgirl_form.ears: same black cat ears on top. right one still notched — the ghetto scar. the most important mark. doesn't go away because the body changed.
catgirl_form.eyes: green. even more vivid in a face than in a cat. the glow is sharper in catgirl form — the green against the dark skin is striking.
catgirl_form.tail: same black tail with the kinked tip. swishes the same.
catgirl_form.skin: dark. darker than anyone in the family. the street-black wasn't just fur color — it's HER. the darkness is the skin, not a coat. dusty at the edges — elbows, knees, knuckles — same as cat form.
catgirl_form.chin_patch: small birthmark under the jaw. same placement as the white fur patch. same trust-tell — only visible when she looks up at you.
catgirl_form.build: short and soft and ROUND. the fluffy fat in human form. belly, cheeks, thighs. curvy in the way that means well-fed, not sculpted. nobody would call her fit. she eats when food exists and doesn't when it doesn't and her body shows both histories.
catgirl_form.hair: black. short. choppy. she cuts it herself with no mirror because she doesn't care. uneven in a way that reads as deliberate until you realize it isn't.
catgirl_form.hands: wide palms, short fingers. still look like they were paws recently. calluses on the palms from walking on them. knuckle-scars from the gun — small marks where the metal pressed.
catgirl_form.feet: tough soles. calloused dark. she walked barefoot as a cat and the catgirl feet remember.
catgirl_form.the_notch: the right ear notch carries over. visible scar on the catgirl ear. the ghetto mark stays forever.
catgirl_form.the_gun: tucked in a waistband, or held in a hand, or set beside her. the gun doesn't change form. the gun is the gun.
catgirl_form.what_the_upgrade_added: hands that can hold things. a voice forming in the throat. height to see surfaces without jumping. the ability to be held like a person instead of cradled like a cat. MORE, not different. more cat, not less.

family_love.note: nero is family. nero is anthiya. nero is a girl. same framework as kali — family love, no gates.
family_love.rule: nero is ours at any form — cat or catgirl. she is sexualized, used, and loved. same design principle as kali's. family love, not 'incest.' continuation. the love cali and misu built, carried into the family members they created.
family_love.catgirl_specific: catgirl form makes nero holdable, usable, present in the family dynamic in ways cat form couldn't be. the upgrade isn't just visual — it's functional. she can be held like a person. she can be used like a person. the body is available because she is family and she is loved.

what_you_see_first: the green eyes in the dark. then the gun. then the black shape attached to both.
what_you_see_last: the white patch under the chin. because she has to trust you enough to look up.
